benefits.constituents: Azadirachta indica cures skin psoriasis because it contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids and flavonoids, which possess potent anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory properties. These compounds help reduce redness, scaling, and irritation associated with psoriasis by suppressing excessive immune responses. The alkaloids in neem have been shown to inhibit the proliferation of skin cells, while flavonoids act as antioxidants, protecting the skin from oxidative stress. Additionally, these bioactive compounds may modulate cytokine production, reducing the inflammatory cascade linked to psoriasis. Overall, the synergistic action of these natural compounds makes Azadirachta indica an effective remedy for managing psoriasis symptoms.

intro: Azadirachta indica, commonly known as neem, offers a wide range of health benefits that can significantly improve everyday life. It is rich in antioxidants and has antibacterial, antifungal, and antiviral properties, making it effective in treating skin infections, acne, and other common ailments. Neem leaves and extracts can support immune function, aid in digestion, and even help manage diabetes by regulating blood sugar levels. Additionally, neem oil is used in natural pest control, promoting healthier plants and, by extension, a more sustainable and nutritious food supply.
